lines.en: : I’m back! And I brought wieners! The vibratey, rubbery kind! With ten different speeds and settings that are sure to blow your-
: Sensei!
: No, Miku. There is no fellatio option on a vibrator...nor do I understand how you would ever believe there to be one in the first place.
: No, I’m sayin’ Sensei is here! And Maki says I ain’t supposed to be marketin’ these things to boys unless they give me any tells.
: Oh. Well, I suppose that’s not the most surprising thing that’s ever happened to me. Especially on account of him practically living here.
: But what are you guys-
: Oh snap. Maki broke out the Makoto doppelganger sex tape and is now watching it alone in a room with Sensei. This is probably weird, but I don’t know why.
: Makoto...I swear there is a perfectly good reason for this.
: Oh, yes. I’m sure there is, Mother.

: Maybe you can tell me all about it when you’re not too busy sticking your fucking nose where it doesn’t belong and trying to sabotage what few connections I’ve actually been able to make as the daughter of a fucking...insatiable cock peddler!
: I just wanted to make sure he could see this without-
: Without what?! And before you go actually answering that question, it’s a rhetorical one because your answer doesn’t fucking matter! In what world is this how you solve anything?!
: It...made sense to me! And Akira’s already seen it! So if we watched it together-

: Yeah, I’m gonna stop you right there and tell you there’s not really any way you can justify teaming up with my teacher to watch a video of some girl who looks nearly identical to me getting spitroasted in a classroom.
: Which is kind of an absurd thing for me to have to say, but this is the type of mother I was born with.
: One who probably doesn’t even know what rhetorical means because she’s more concerned with looking like a parent than actually being one.
: I’m trying my best!
: You’re watching fucking porn with my teacher! That’s your best?! That’s fucking stupid! Can you do literally anything that doesn’t involve sex?!
: And don’t answer that either because I know you’re just trying to force his hand and poke him until he says what you want to hear! Or don’t want to hear!
: But either way, who’s pressuring who now, Mom? I thought you wanted to protect him after all he’s been through. That we were the ones pressuring him. What changed?
: Can we at least...try to discuss this calmly?...
: No! This is, like...fucking coercion or something! Or blackmail! And even without that, is a complete violation of my privacy! Which, yes, I am entitled to despite still being in high school!
: Uhh...guys?
: Sensei? What’s-
: Move.
: You’re just gonna leave me here?...
: Makoto, don’t yell at me! I’m still your mother whether you like it or not!
: Oh no, you’re totally right. I haven’t even heard why you thought something this disgusting and creepy would be a good idea yet. So by all means, go ahead. Convince me.
: It’s not you in that video, Makoto.
: Ah! It’s not?! All this time, I had no idea! Why, that changes everything!
: Don’t give me the opportunity to speak if you’re just going to mock me...
: Then stop making it so fucking easy! No matter how you spin it, there’s no way this was the right thing to do unless you were just trying to entrap him.
: So of course that’s what you wound up doing since your mental capacity is packed so full of jizz that there’s no more room for any of the fucking morals you pretend to have, Mom!
: So tell me! Did you enjoy watching a girl who looks like me get her brains fucked out on TV? Did you and Sensei get to bond over that? Boy, I sure hope I didn’t interrupt anything else.
: No! I didn’t enjoy it! But in my head, I thought pressuring him would be the only way I’d ever hear anything since you won’t talk to me either.
: And if you won’t talk to me and he won’t talk to me, then what am I supposed to do, Makoto?! Not protect you?
: Wow, yeah. That’s a tough predicament to be caught up in. But have you considered maybe juuuuust shutting the fuck up and minding your own business?
: It’s been minding my own business that led to this in the first place! I should have asked him how he felt years ago! It’s just so disgusting that I thought he was above that!
: Disgusting?! Then you’re fucking complicit now, idiot! You just decided he was something and tried to force it out of him!
: Which makes you the most abusive person I know now! And you didn’t even have to fucking touch anybody to get there!
: You...take that back! I’m a lot of things, sure! But abusive isn’t one of them! I’d never do anything to hurt you!
: This hurts me! Letting countless men use you like a plaything when I was supposed to be looking up to you hurt me! So for someone who doesn’t want to, you sure do it a lot!
: I already told you I’m trying! No one teaches you how to do this! I’m learning as I go!
: Don’t fucking blame it on teaching when it’s thanks to you that I learned what fucking sixty-nining was before I could even count that high! You had no problem teaching me that!
: Because that’s all I know!
: Then fucking learn something else! And stop convincing yourself I’m fucking my teacher just because it makes you feel like you’re actually fucking doing something for-
: AAAHHHHAHHHHHH!!!! WHAAAHAHAHHAHHHH!!!!!!!
: Well...
: I mean...don’t cry.
: Can ya really blame her? With the way you laid into her like that, I kinda wanna cry too now.
: You saw what they were watching. You saw how uncomfortable Sensei looked. And I’m sure you saw what she was trying to get out of it too.
: Of course I’m going to be mad. This is nothing if not the greatest parental overstep I have ever witnessed.
: Maybe. But at least you have parents who will overstep like that for you.
: So you shouldn’t ever say anything to ‘em that you ain’t comfortable havin’ as your last words. You never know when they’ll be gone.
: I’M...SO...SORRY!!! MAKOTO!!! I’M SORRY!!!! I’VE...FAILED...YOU!!!!!
: No, I...I mean, yes, but...you don’t have to cry! Just...do you want me to go to my room? Do you want to ground me? Go ahead. Ground me. I’ll go. Just...stop crying. Please.
: Just get her a box of tissues...
: I think we’re gonna be down here for a while...
: I’M SUCH...A TERRIBLE MOTHER! HOW...COULD I BE...SO STUPID?! WHY...CAN’T I...EVER DO...THE RIGHT THING?!
: No! No...I mean...I guess on a technical level, your heart was in the right place. You just...did the actual weirdest, creepiest, grossest thing to try and address it that-
: AAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHAHAHAHAHAHAHHHHH!!!!! WAAAHAAHAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!!!!!
: Maki, what Makoto’s tryin’ to say is that it really ain’t as bad as it looks.
: Uhh...I mean...
: Just let me handle this, Makoto.
: You...shouldn’t...even...be here...Miku! I’ll just...ruin your life...too!
: I don’t know about that, Maki. I don’t even know where I’d be right now if it wasn’t for you guys. You’re just as much my mom as you are Makoto’s.
: Then...I’m sorry for...failing you too! I can’t...do this! I need...Masahiro! I can’t! I can’t!
: There ain’t nothin’ he coulda done that you can’t, Maki. Gettin’ people to understand where yer comin’ from is just kinda tough sometimes. But that don’t mean you can just give up.
: But...Makoto’s...right! She’s more...mature than me! Who am I...to tell her...what she can...and can’t do?!
: And Akira! He trusted me! He trusted me and I did that to him! After all he’s been through! This was wrong! Why...did I...do something...so stupid?!
: You were tryin’ to get him to admit to somethin’, huh? You think he’s horny for Makoto?
: Miku, that’s-
: That right, Maki? You think they’re up to somethin’ no good?
: It’d be...more surprising...if they weren’t...at this point...
: But he was...supposed to be...my friend! How could he...do this...to my own daughter?!
: You don’t know if he did anything, though. You just decided he did and tried to trick him into blurtin’ it out, yeah? That really what friends do?
: I probably...suck at...being a friend too! That’s certainly how...Haruka and...Sara made me feel...the last time...we hung out!
: Well, if my opinion matters, which it doesn’t usually since I’m the dumbest outta everybody, I don’t think you’re doin’ a bad job. I think you’re just confused and scared and that’s fine.
: Everybody gets like that. And everybody cries sometimes, so you ain’t gotta feel bad about that either.
: I’m sorry...to both of you...it’s just...
: I know I...try to be open and...teach you girls about all this stuff...but there are things I don’t...think you’re ready for yet...and I...
: I don’t want you...to be like me...
: There are worse people to be like, Maki. We know you’re tryin’.
: Hah...
: Uhh...
: So, I...I don’t really know how to tell you this, but...
: But there’s something I probably should tell you if...if it gets you to stop...openly agonizing like this. I just didn’t think you’d, like...actually cry.
: Makoto?...
: ...Makoto?
: Mom, I...
: Well, Sensei and I...
: I have an older boyfriend!
: What?...
: What?
: I, uhh...it’s some guy I met online. And the whole...broken vagina thing? That was actually him...
: I just didn’t wanna say anything since it was...embarrassing and stuff...
: You...met someone online?...
: I got kinda curious with some stuff I’ve been feelin’ and...wound up makin’ one of those Tinder profiles to try and...explore that.
: He ain’t a bad guy, but...he probably shouldn’t be porkin’ a high schooler. And I probably shouldn’t be lettin’ him, but...I don’t know. I kinda like it?...
: But I know not everybody does. Which is probably why Makoto’s been tryin’ to talk me out of it for so long. Right, Makoto?
: Uh...yeah. I hate that guy and...anyone who would prey upon a high schooler. Even if that’s a contradictory stance to take given things I’ve said in the recent past.
: So if it seems Makoto’s been hidin’ somethin’, it’s probably that. I just feel bad for holdin’ it in for so long since it’s clearly gettin’ between you guys...
: Sniff.
: Miku...why are you telling me this?
: I just don’t want things gettin’ any worse for anybody else. And I don’t want you gettin’ suspicious of the people I care about for bein’ worse than they actually are.
: I’m sorry for hidin’ it, Maki. I know you’re probably disappointed in me, so...I’ll stop if you really want me to.
: In just a few years, though?...Won’t matter. I’ll be able to date whoever I want without anybody sayin’ anything. That’s just how far we are from freedom, I guess.
: I’m...going to go clean myself up now...
: I’m sorry you two got wrapped up in all of this tonight...
: Miku, what the fuck was that?
: Lyin’s friggin’ hard. I don’t get how some people do it so often.
: No, I get that. But why? She was way more suspicious of me than you. You didn’t need to come up with a whole story to try and frame me as the good guy when I am absolutely not.
: I know I didn’t need to. But I ain’t about to let you go and blow your cover like that because you feel bad in the moment. The heck would hidin’ it for so long be good for then?
: But now things are just going to get harder for you.
: She’ll see through all of the holes in your story soon if she doesn’t already. Then, the question will just become “why?” and we’ll be right back where we started.
: But that’ll give ya time to come up with a better plan, right? ‘Sides, what are friends for if not stickin’ up for each other when we’re about to do somethin’ stupid?
: Course, that’s all assumin’ she finds any holes in my story at all. For all we know, I’m actually a super convincing liar and I just never realized it?
: Miku...thank you.
: Makoto, if you really want to thank me, go apologize to your mom.
: You were really mean to her even if she did something as creepy and gross as watchin’ your secret twin suck three wangs at once.
: I will...
: I just have something I need to set on fire first.
: Can I maybe hang onto it instead? Never know when ya can use a little blackmail.
: Hah...I’m starting to feel like you’re even more her daughter than I am.
